DRAFT.runtime: local draft files; no live Matrix required
invariants: never disclose credentials; reset draft is not remove server

ADMIN.runtime: saved identity; changes of access require Synapse/MAS
invariants: created bot identity immutable; protect primary/service accounts; do not confuse MAS admin and panel access

RELCHECK.runtime: trusted local installation and release service network
invariants: unknown release is not up-to-date; preserve installed version on failure

RELLATEST.runtime: trusted installation; network; backup/database and update readiness
invariants: nonzero outcome when apply unconfirmed; pinned version; no automatic major upgrade

FEATURE.runtime: existing-compose only; source plan and runtime dependencies
invariants: never apply portable initialization to adopted stack; preserve owners and identity

HOME.runtime: saved installation; Caddy/public route for publish
invariants: preserve Matrix/MAS API routes; restart only required service; keep rollback checkpoint

FED.runtime: local policy for reads; remote API for exchange; live auth for bots
invariants: local allowlist differs from mutual connection; keep event IDs and partial checkpoints

UI.runtime: local TTY; installed runtime for existing server
invariants: navigation only; do not start mutations merely by opening a menu

INIT.runtime: trusted bundle and root host; no existing Matrix required
invariants: refuse foreign nonempty target; initialization is not ready service
generation does not by itself prove running services

CONFIG.runtime: saved model; readiness only for apply
invariants: immutable identity preserved; pending configuration recover before conflicting mutation
public service origins are fixed after startup; updates and restore preserve the saved host map
failed prerequisite must preserve a concrete safe reason
modify only owned wrapper; keep runtime and secrets separate

STATUS.runtime: local metadata; Docker may be unavailable
invariants: status is not end-to-end messaging proof; preserve unknown and pending states
uploaded != restore-verified; old verified record != latest; unknown != false

CHECK.runtime: target services and public network endpoints
invariants: failed DNS/TLS/HTTP remains failure; never echo raw provider secrets

LIFE.runtime: CLI start can begin stopped stack; bots need live authorization
invariants: stop preserves data; restart keeps previously stopped optional services; pending/frozen blocks unsafe start

REMOVE.runtime: root TTY; owned installation and explicit confirmations
invariants: never delete foreign resources or remove data through stop

PASSWORD.runtime: private input; live MAS/Synapse; backup readiness
invariants: ordinary user reset uses forward recovery; initial admin rotation has its own rollback; never echo password

INVITE.runtime: local first-token state and live MAS/Synapse for issuance
invariants: bootstrap first token differs from member invitations; list omits codes; replacement explicitly revokes old token

SECRET.runtime: root TTY and locally retained initial credentials
invariants: do not invent external MAS password; no password in logs or bots

MEDIA.runtime: saved installation; local/S3 dependencies by stage
invariants: preserve original media/checkpoint; no implicit S3 destination change

DATABASE.runtime: owned local databases and dedicated target; stage-specific readiness
invariants: abort only before activation; preserve identity and checkpoint on interruption
portable create is local; verify is temporary restore; external MAS scope explicit; restore prior writer state

EXTERNAL.runtime: private S3 profile and separate recovery key; provider connectivity
invariants: preserve local copy; verify download/decryption; cleanup only exact owned object

RESTORE.runtime: trusted archive/key; empty target; activation requires stopped source
invariants: staged restore is not activation; never run two copies of same identity

SCHEDULE.runtime: local systemd setup; timer execution has backup dependencies
invariants: preserve foreign units; enabled != executed; Result=success without metadata != verified backup

LOCALUPDATE.runtime: trusted local source and installation; backup/checkpoint
invariants: preserve identity; no old runtime on incompatible schema; recover from retained checkpoint

DBCREDS.runtime: owned databases and healthy stack before rotate
invariants: change only application roles; checkpoint survives partial writes

S3CREDS.runtime: same S3 destination and current/new private credentials
invariants: rotate credentials only; keep exact pending new pair; cleanup only own probes

VAULT.runtime: private Vault profile/auth; local state plus provider
invariants: recover missing credentials without overwriting unrelated state; disconnect retains remote versions

S3PROBE.runtime: private profile and S3 provider; no live Matrix required
invariants: read-only never PUT; not_checked differs from failed; cleanup exact owned probe

member.invite.role: active local member; Telegram MAS login or private encrypted Matrix chat
invariants: own codes only; event retry cannot create duplicate; member code is not CLI first token

member.invitations.runtime: bot/control/MAS; Matrix requires private encrypted chat
invariants: pagination retains ownership; expired/used/revoked not active
cannot revoke another member code; numbered choice bound to shown ID

admin.restart.role: current MAS admin; Matrix additionally panel allowlist
admin.restart.runtime: portable repeat auth needs Synapse; detached systemd execution
invariants: durable execution survives bot restart; no replay after uncertain outcome

admin.statistics.role: current MAS admin; Matrix additionally panel allowlist
admin.statistics.runtime: bot/control/auth; counters need database; host samples separate
invariants: missing counters stay unknown; period applies to activity, not CPU snapshot
queued is not completed; saved result tied to actor; history navigation is not replay

admin.broadcast.role: current MAS admin in panel allowlist
admin.broadcast.runtime: private encrypted chat, controller, persistent outbox
invariants: preview before send; queued recipient count is not delivered count; no duplicate from replay

admin.welcome.role: current MAS admin in panel allowlist
invariants: change only future greetings; preserve literal text; do not greet old users on restart

admin.notifications.role: current MAS admin in panel allowlist
invariants: preferences currently global; disabling cancels queued matching notices

telegram.login.role: local MAS account confirmed by device authorization
invariants: Telegram username does not grant access; new binding transfers only same MAS account

admin.components.role: current MAS admin; Matrix additionally panel allowlist
admin.components.runtime: bot/control/auth; saved feature state and public links; portable path is not existing-compose CLI features status
invariants: read only; component configuration is not verified health; native and adopted stacks have different backends

member.invitation-detail.runtime: bot/control/MAS; selected ID belongs to caller
invariants: compact list does not expose full codes; explicit selection reads own code and expiry; no regeneration on read
